resolution.title: [gbsyncd]: add gbsyncd to FEATURE table
resolution.description:
**- Why I did it**
remove syncd from critical process list because
gbsyncd process will exit for platform without
gearbox.

closes #5623

Signed-off-by: Guohan Lu <<EMAIL>>

**- How I did it**
remove syncd from critical process list because
gbsyncd process will exit for platform without
gearbox.

**- How to verify it**
apply the fix, reboot the box and check all gbsyncd related syslog message.

**- Which release branch to backport (provide reason below if selected)**

- [ ] 201911
